hmmm. For 100 dollars... What keyswitch do you prefer? If you don't know:

  • Cherry MX red - no tactile bump, short travel distance, no clickyness
  • Cherry MX Blue - tactile bump, Clicky, short travel distance
  • Cherry MX brown- Tactile bump, Shorter travel distance going down then going up, not clicky
  • Cherry MX black - like red, but longer travel distance
  • Cherry MX green - Like blue, but takes more force to press
    there are other colors as well, but you would be hard pressed to find them. Hell, green and black are hard enough. If unsure, go with red or blue.

Regular or 10keyless? (basically, do you want the numberpad). I prefer having the numberpad, since I use it a lot, but having a smaller board means less desk space taken up, and, depending on the width of your shoulders, could mean a better distance between each hand whilst gaming...
